notes: 13 new heroes and a new rarity above Primordial: the Aeons (Aion, Ananke, Phanes; 1 in 2,000 summons, guaranteed by 600) with their own time-stopping ultimates. Also Erebus (Primordial), Hera and Demeter (Olympians), Theseus and Bellerophon (Demigods), Ariadne and Pandora (Legendary), Narcissus and Echo (Famed) and the Pankratiast (Mortal), each with a passive, signature ultimate and sound, 4 skins, a myth and new bonds.
